turns.question: What is the address of Union Station in Washington, DC?
turns.shown:
**Union Station, Washington, DC is at 50 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002.**

- The station's own contact page lists it as 50 Massachusetts Ave., NE, Washington, D.C. 20002, with phone [phone removed]. [1]
- Amtrak lists the same street address, with the longer ZIP+4 of 20002-4214. [2]
- One bus-listing site gives the ZIP as 20001. I'd go with 20002, since the station and Amtrak both use it.
- The station sits in front of Columbus Circle, where Massachusetts Avenue meets Delaware and Louisiana Avenues and E and First Streets NE. [3]
- Amtrak says pick-up and drop-off is at the Massachusetts Avenue exit. [2] That may help if you're being picked up or dropped off.

I haven't checked whether the entrances or pick-up areas have temporary changes, such as construction. Check the station's website if you're going soon.

Sources
[1] Contact Us — https://www.unionstationdc.com/contact-us/ (search result age: 168 days ago)
[2] Washington, DC - Union Station (WAS) — https://www.amtrak.com/stations/was (search result age: 285 days ago)
[3] Columbus Circle (Washington, D.C.) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbus_Circle_(Washington,_D.C.)
